description: Owner-approved license exceptions for the two license gates (D-00, D-18, D-26). `exceptions` is for the NuGet license gate in tools/scripts/New-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1: a package is exempt only when BOTH its id and its exact version match an entry. Any other version of these packages, and any other package outside docs/allowed-licenses.json, still fails the gate. A new version needs a new owner approval. `npmLicenseExceptions` is for the npm license gate in web/scripts/license-gate.mjs: those exceptions are license-level (any package under that license) and apply only to the dev/build/tool trees of web/ and tools/openapi-gen/, each only for the scopes it lists (build, test or tool, from the docs/dependencies.json scope of the direct dependencies that pull a package in). They never apply to the production tree that ships to the browser, which allows only docs/allowed-licenses.json plus OFL-1.1 for the @fontsource fonts. In both gates, an entry that no longer matches a package also fails (for npm, so does a listed scope that no package needs), so the lists cannot go stale. Never widen this file to make a gate pass: a new license needs the owner's approval first.
